plantedContradictions.subject: Go-live date
plantedContradictions.sideA: WhatsApp, Tom De Vries: board wants it live before peak season, end of October, not negotiable
plantedContradictions.sideB: Transcript 2, Priya Nair: realistically we're looking at Q1 next year, nothing goes live in October
plantedContradictions.whyItMatters: No single document contains this. It exists only across the corpus, which is exactly why reading files one at a time misses it.

plantedContradictions.subject: Number of users
